<<Notes on Repointing A Chimney Stack>>

Repointing a chimney stack is a crucial maintenance task that ensures the structural integrity and efficiency of your chimney. It involves replacing deteriorated or damaged mortar between the bricks to prevent cracks, leaks, and potential fire hazards. This process is typically done by a professional chimney sweep or a qualified contractor, who uses a specialized tool to remove the old mortar and apply new, high-quality mortar that matches the original. The work is often performed during the winter months when the chimney is less active, minimizing disruption to your daily life. Volunteers can play a valuable role in this process, especially in community-driven projects, by assisting with the cleanup and organizing the event. P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
